name: DEV JAVIA
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A left-handed player with a strong serve and powerful forehand, effective on hard and clay courts.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #632 (November 18, 2024), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #614 (December 23, 2024).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw; reached the second round of Wimbledon Juniors (2019).
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 1 ITF Futures singles title (2023 M15 Jakarta) and 1 doubles title (2024 M15 Nakhon Si Thammarat). Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 374 Dominik Palan at the 2024 ITF M15 Nakhon Si Thammarat. Junior Success: Achieved a career-high ITF Junior Ranking of #54 (2019) and won the 2019 MCC National Junior U-18 Clay Court Championship. Davis Cup & National Representation: Yet to debut in Davis Cup but named to India’s Junior Davis Cup team (2018).
Other Highlights: Trains at the IMPACT Tennis Academy in Bangkok under Mark Gellard (former coach of Nick Kyrgios). Won gold at the 2020 Khelo India Youth Games (U-17). Aims to break into the ATP Top 200 by 2026.
Dev is a promising talent in Indian tennis, steadily climbing the ranks with a focus on physical and mental growth. 🎾🇮🇳
